canonical_name: LINE BITMAX 暗号資産貸出サービス
aliases: BITMAX 暗号資産貸出サービス
summary: Historical crypto-asset lending service within LINE BITMAX. The service launched in October 2020, later offered variable- and fixed-period lending, and ended as LINE Xenesis shut down the entire LINE BITMAX service in 2026.
what_happened: LVC Corporation announced the BITMAX crypto-asset lending service for launch on 2020-10-07. Later first-party help material documents variable-period and fixed-period courses in which users lent crypto assets to the operator and received lending fees. LINE BITMAX later operated under LINE Xenesis株式会社. On 2026-03-03 LINE Xenesis / LY Corporation announced that LINE BITMAX would end on 2026-06-01. The official shutdown site states that new lending applications were stopped and existing lending contracts would be ended sequentially during the shutdown process. CYA uses 2026-06-01 as the platform/product-family end date while preserving that individual lending contracts may have ended earlier. The shutdown asset-return procedure is recorded as a service-end process, not proof of universal historical lending performance.
uncertainty_notes: Launch-era operator was LVC Corporation while shutdown-era operator was LINE Xenesis株式会社. The exact termination date of every individual lending contract is not established as identical to the 2026-06-01 platform shutdown date. Historical campaign and lending rates remain issuer terms rather than verified realized returns.
notes: Promoted in Phase 10 from duplicate-clear candidate cya_candidate_000131 after candidate-only PR #235 passed the hardened full-corpus scanner against the 112-platform canonical corpus.
